en: • From ``Mobile Suit Gundam UC'', the Banshee appears in the glow of titanium. ■By adding one molded product, elaborate color coding is possible. ■Comes with a metallic water transfer decal that matches the shine of the titanium finish. ■Equipped with a transformation mechanism to unicorn mode. Molded product x 22, foil seal x 1, water transfer decal x 1, assembly manual x 1
